record: Ventspils Museum account of the Livonian Order Castle
facts: The castle originated in the late 13th century and has housed the museum since 2001.
The masonry tower was incorporated into the southeastern corner of the convent building.

record: Official city account of the restored museum
facts: The convent complex includes the chapel and four wings. The 2012 renovation opened the cathedral and upper rooms to the public.
The current museum courtyard is covered by a glass roof.
